title: Scriptc by Vercel: TypeScript-to-Native compiler, no JavaScript engine in binary
summary: Scriptc is an experimental TypeScript-to-native compiler developed by Vercel Labs that compiles TypeScript code directly to standalone native binaries without embedding any JavaScript runtime engine, making it ideal for resource-constrained environments and edge deployment scenarios.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for heavy JavaScript runtime engines when deploying TypeScript applications, enabling truly lightweight native executables.
why_valuable: It allows TypeScript developers to ship dependency-free native binaries that start instantly and consume minimal memory, perfect for serverless functions, embedded systems, and CLI tools.
